short_summary.value: Decodes a 64-bit instruction payload into a 187-bit decoded control bundle for downstream execution.
short_summary.explanation: The module takes a 64-bit instruction (i_data_64) and splits it into two 32-bit halves (w_pc_32, w_int_32). The w_int_32 half is further decomposed into 16-bit sub-fields (w_int1_16, w_int2_16) which are then decoded via a large set of combinatorial assignments to produce individual instruction-type flags (e.g., w_addMI12_1, w_B_1) and operand selectors (e.g., w_rnOp1, w_rmOp1). These decoded signals are aggregated into a single 187-bit output (o_data_187) that represents the fully decoded instruction ready for launch.
